studies.description: Wind threaded through autumn hardwood canopy: real wood-leaf microtexture; open space not harsh icy barren summit; restrained no coin-clank or bird show.
Dry open fields gradually recovering, quiet wind through grasses, sound of air not eternal smoke/fire, no generic jungle insects.
Genuinely enclosed working Ogre/Crown signal shelter, attenuated recognizable ridge foliage plus sparse soft timber flex, no invented horn/crowd or acoustic emptiness.
Inhabited Orc barracks workspace with outer recovering Frontier air softened by walls, one muted lived-in wooden handling gesture, no invented ritual/army drill loop.

findings: Highland true decoded sample peak .502 at second ~50 and .419 at ~52 despite integrated -32.73 LUFS; too much isolated transient headroom for restrained ambient bed. Apply monotone smooth-knee sample saturation only above .17 amplitude and re-measure encoded audio, not a global ambient bus change.

Interior recorded field fraction only 7.7% Keep and 15.4% Barracks; original procedural air still dominates while the claim is convincing environmental physical texture. Increase attenuated real field percentage to ~27-32% while leaving physical enclosure filters, route gains and music unchanged.

Original first/last 1sec RMS differences ~1.5–2.4 dB outdoors, ~0.14–2.29 indoors; source seam sample jumps .0005–.0035. Add decoded first/last RMS gate and sample-peak/true-peak evidence rather than assuming a numerically small boundary jump alone proves loop smoothness.
